audit.why: HARD at 7/10 with 47.28% over 588 games. Illaoi's tentacle field grows for free while Sejuani's damage does not scale, and Prophet of an Elder God heals her off every arm that connects, so extended trades inside her field are unwinnable regardless of how the CC lands.

audit.whatIsWrong: The mid block says that after she uses her spirit pull, 'her next 8 seconds are her weakest'.
audit.why: Test of Spirit is 16/15/14/13/12 seconds. Eight is not a rank of that ability, and a player timing an all-in on a fabricated eight-second window will walk into a spirit pull that is still four to eight seconds from coming back. This is the kind of number that gets someone killed.
audit.corrected: Replaced with the real 16 seconds at rank 1, framed as the window that shrinks as she ranks it.

audit.whatIsWrong: Her abilities are attached to the wrong slots in three places. (a) wants.foe[0]: 'Pull your spirit with Leap of Faith (E)' — the spirit pull is Test of Spirit (E); Leap of Faith is her R. (b) spikes[3]: 'Prophet of an Elder God (E spirit pull)' — Prophet of an Elder God is her passive. (c) late: 'her Elder God (R) summons a tentacle per enemy champion hit' — that is Leap of Faith. Plus Glacial Prison is called a comet again.
audit.why: Riot's slots: P Prophet of an Elder God (tentacles spawn on impassable terrain, and they heal Illaoi), Q Tentacle Smash, W Harsh Lesson (a 4-second leap to her target that also swings nearby tentacles at it), E Test of Spirit (16/15/14/13/12s, rips the spirit out and echoes damage back to the original), R Leap of Faith (120/95/70s, spawns a tentacle per champion hit). Three of five slots were mislabelled on the same page, and the E/R swap is the dangerous one because the page tells you to track the wrong cooldown.
audit.corrected: All three slots corrected; the passive's healing stated as the reason extended trades lose; bola replaces comet.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns correctly names Test of Spirit as matchup-defining but gives no number, and Harsh Lesson — the ability she actually presses most — appears nowhere.
audit.why: Test of Spirit 16/15/14/13/12s at 900 range; Harsh Lesson 4s flat at 400; Tentacle Smash 10/9/8/7/6s at 850; Leap of Faith 120/95/70s. A 4-second leap that also resets her attack means there is no such thing as waiting out her W — the only cooldown worth counting is the 16-second E.
audit.corrected: Both numbers written into the cooldown block, report[5], phases[3] and loading.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Add anti-heal early into his sustain' — wrong pronoun, no heal source, no item.
audit.why: Riot on Prophet of an Elder God: the tentacles 'deal physical damage to enemies hit, and will heal Illaoi'. Her sustain is not incidental, it is the passive, and it scales with how many arms are up — which is exactly the fight the page tells you to avoid. Thornmail is already on the build path and carries Grievous Wounds.
audit.corrected: Thornmail named and tied to the tentacle healing.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page addresses what Leap of Faith does to Arctic Assault, and the kit file's derived flags claim it grounds and makes her untargetable.
audit.why: If Leap of Faith grounds, your only gap-close and only escape is disabled for its duration, which would be the single most important fact in the matchup for an immobile tank. But Riot's own description says only 'Illaoi smashes her idol into the ground, dealing physical damage to nearby enemies. A Tentacle spawns for each enemy champion hit' — no grounding, no untargetability. The kit file's needsResearch block is empty by design, so this cannot be settled from local data and was not written.

edits.after: Levels 4 and 5 are the most dangerous window to overcommit — Illaoi's tentacle field grows organically as the lane goes on, and with Harsh Lesson on 4 seconds and Tentacle Smash on 10 she sustains through chip damage off her passive and punishes any engage that walks her into three or more arms. Play at max auto range and use Winter's Wrath (W) to apply Frost without stepping fully into her kill zone; let her tentacles expire on minions instead of you. At level 6 the math shifts: Glacial Prison is a 1300-range initiation she cannot dash away from. Land the bola from outside her tentacle field, walk up through the storm, and chain Permafrost before a tentacle can reset her HP. If she has spent Test of Spirit on your spirit and you survived it, the next 16 seconds at rank 1 are her weakest — that is when you throw R and run the all-in.
edits.before: Levels 4 and 5 are the most dangerous window to overcommit — Illaoi's tentacle field grows organically as the lane goes on, and with Harsh Lesson and Tentacle Smash on low cooldowns she can sustain through chip damage and punish any engage attempt that walks her into three or more arms. Play at max auto range and use Winter's Wrath (W) to apply Frost passively without stepping fully into her kill zone; let her tentacles expire on minions instead of you. At level 6 the math shifts: Glacial Prison is a long-range initiation she cannot dash away from. Land R from outside her tentacle field, walk up through the blizzard zone, and chain E-stun before a tentacle can reset her HP. If she has already used Leap of Faith (E) on your spirit and you survived it, her next 8 seconds are her weakest — that is exactly when you throw R and run the all-in.

edits.after: In the late game Illaoi becomes a siege-breaker and teamfight anchor that hard-counters walking into her — Leap of Faith summons a tentacle for every enemy champion it hits and turns any clustered fight into a bloodbath on her terms. Your job is never to run into a five-tentacle hallway for her: use Glacial Prison from 1300 to pull her or a priority target into YOUR CC chain rather than walking into hers. In a side lane 1v1 with items behind her she will out-sustain and out-damage you through the tentacle pattern, so respect it. Your value late is entirely as an engage initiator — land R on a squishy, Permafrost the pile, and let your team clean up while Illaoi is too far from her field to decide the fight.

notes: Three of Illaoi's five ability slots were mislabelled on this page: the spirit pull was credited to 'Leap of Faith (E)' in wants.foe[0], the passive was credited to 'Prophet of an Elder God (E spirit pull)' in spikes[3], and the ultimate was called 'Elder God (R)' in the late block. The E/R confusion is the dangerous one, because the page's whole win condition is timing an all-in on the spirit-pull cooldown and it was pointing at the wrong ability. Compounding that, the mid block invented an eight-second recovery window; Test of Spirit is 16/15/14/13/12 seconds, so someone following the page would step forward roughly eight seconds too early. UNVERIFIED and deliberately not written: the kit file's derived flags put 'grounding' and 'untargetable' on Leap of Faith. If grounding is real it disables Arctic Assault outright and would be the most important line on the page for an immobile tank — but Riot's own description of the ability mentions neither, and per the kit file's own warning a derived flag that outruns the description cannot be trusted. This needs one authoritative check on the League Wiki before it is written anywhere.
